1.content:
# Microsoft 365 & Azure — network experience (OneAgent flows)
Outbound flows from monitored hosts to Microsoft endpoints, classified by destination IP against published M365 and Azure ranges.

> **Categories** follow Microsoft's connectivity principles: **Optimize** (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive) is latency-sensitive and should egress locally and bypass proxies/SSL inspection · **Allow** (Entra ID, M365 Common) should go direct where possible · **Default** is everything else (Azure, Microsoft edge/Front Door). Pick **Select all** on the **Service** filter the first time you open the dashboard.

21.title: Microsoft traffic over time — by service

30.content:
## Latency & reliability
RTT is measured by OneAgent on the TCP connection from the host to the Microsoft front end — it reflects the network path (proxy, VPN, WAN egress), not the service itself.

52.title: Routing check — Optimize traffic direct vs via proxy
52.query:
fetch events, bucket:{"default_network_flows"}
| filter in(host.name, array($Host))
| filter network_flow.process_is_server == false
| fieldsAdd path = coalesce(if(ipIn(network_flow.destination.address, "13.107.6.152/31", "13.107.18.10/31", "13.107.128.0/22", "23.103.160.0/20", "40.96.0.0/13", "40.104.0.0/15", "52.96.0.0/14", "131.253.33.215/32", "132.245.0.0/16", "150.171.32.0/22", "204.79.197.215/32", "13.107.64.0/18", "52.112.0.0/14", "52.122.0.0/15", "13.107.136.0/22", "40.108.128.0/17", "52.104.0.0/14", "104.146.128.0/17", "150.171.40.0/22"), "direct"), if(ipIn(network_flow.destination.address, "104.129.192.0/20", "136.226.0.0/16", "147.161.128.0/17", "165.225.0.0/16", "185.46.212.0/22"), "proxy"))
| filter isNotNull(path)
| fieldsAdd bytes = coalesce(network_flow.bytes.rx, 0) + coalesce(network_flow.bytes.tx, 0)
| summarize direct_optimize = sum(if(path == "direct", bytes, else: 0)), via_proxy = sum(if(path == "proxy", bytes, else: 0)), by: {host.name}
| fieldsAdd direct_pct = if(direct_optimize + via_proxy > 0, 100.0 * direct_optimize / (direct_optimize + via_proxy), else: 0.0)
| sort direct_pct asc
| limit 25
